## Summary / 摘要

<!-- What changed, and why / 改了什么、为什么 -->

## Type of change / 变更类型

<!-- Tick one and add the matching label — the label decides how the change is grouped in the release notes. -->
<!-- 勾选一项并添加对应标签 —— 标签决定它在发行说明中的归类。 -->

- [ ] `feature` / `enhancement` — new feature / 新功能
- [ ] `bug` / `fix` — bug fix / 问题修复
- [ ] `breaking` — breaking change / 破坏性变更
- [ ] `documentation` / `chore` — docs or maintenance / 文档或维护
- [ ] `skip-changelog` — keep out of the release notes / 不进入发行说明

## Checklist / 自查

- [ ] `gofmt -l .` reports nothing / 无未格式化文件
- [ ] `go build ./...` passes / 构建通过
- [ ] `go test ./... -count=1` passes / 测试通过
- [ ] commits follow Conventional Commits (`feat:` / `fix:` / `docs:` / `chore:` / `ci:`)
- [ ] README / docs updated when behaviour changed / 行为变更时已更新文档
